attempts.observations: A large circle sits above an upper horizontal line, with two smaller circles and zigzags below it. With the supplied title I can weakly associate the upper circle and line with sun/horizon, but I cannot recognize a convincing quiet beach or coherent sunset scene.

Two large circles float above a low horizontal line, with a central vertical stroke and clipped zigzags near the bottom. The large empty upper area and disconnected marks do not read as a sunset over a beach to this observer. Recognition did not improve.

conclusion: Genuine VPS generation and image-feedback delivery are established separately. This observer did not confirm a recognizable final sunset or iterative improvement. The change from3Bto7B and host hardware cannot establish retained learning.
evaluator_disagreement: Gemma described a balance scale and a circuit, and explicitly denied a sunset/beach match, yet reported subject recognition3 then2. These contradictory ratings are preserved, not corrected retroactively.
